result.stdout:
Description:
  ConvertMyImage CLI

Usage:
  cmi [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  convert <TargetFormat> <fileInfo>        Converts image from one format to another (e.g. png -> webp or webp -> png)
  info <FileInfo>                          Shows the info of an file (its name, format and size)
  -v                                       Shows the version of the utility
  ffmpeg                                   Init the ffmpeg folder
  convert-all <TargetFormat> <FolderInfo>  Converts all files in the folder
